tips.text: Run Elite Sanctuary Onslaught solo with a nuke build; public squads leave after two or three zones and host migrations crash runs.
Bring Mirage with Explosive Legerdemain: stack range and strength, open with her 4, and recast 2 as new orbs drop.
Saryn, Volt, Gara, Khora, Atlas, Voruna with Roar, Gyre and Sevagoth also clear it.
Farm Focus in the same runs so the hours are not wasted.
Use recruiting chat if you want a squad, since random squads will not stay.
Players now call the farm reasonable; some finish a full set in an hour.
